identity.title: Podcast directory submission gate packet and blocked disposition

values.summary: Initialize #264, validate terminal podcast prerequisites, implement the non-submission gate packet, run focused proof, obtain exact-head review, publish, finish if the blocked-disposition PR is accepted, and leave external provider work gated.

steps.action: Create authorization, ledger, monitoring, rollback, and parent-handoff materials without provider mutation.
Run focused proof and exact-head review before publication.

invariants: No provider account action without future explicit operator authorization
No unsupported provider acceptance or public-launch claim

risks: A future operator may need to choose per-provider visibility and terms decisions.
Provider UI behavior can change after the #263 sampled official instructions.
A blocked disposition can be overread as submission completion unless the packet is explicit.

Any credential, verification code, mailbox content, or private provider data would be retained
